description: This file implements a CMS image file manager for product images using Infinispan cache. It handles storing, retrieving, and removing product images and related operations specific to product image management in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a product image manager using Infinispan cache, providing methods to add, retrieve, and delete product images related to CMS management.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, likely for cleanup during servlet undeployment.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor to obtain the current instance of the manager.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Stores a product image into the cache based on product and content image details.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image for given product image info; overloaded for different parameters.

methods.name: getImages (by store and content type)
methods.description: Fetches all images for a store and specified content type.

methods.name: getImages (by Product)
methods.description: Fetches all images related to a specific product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific product.

methods.name: getProductImage (with size)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific-sized product image by store code, product code, and image name.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Internal helper to fetch or create a cache node path within Infinispan.

methods.name: setCacheManager
methods.description: Sets the cache manager instance used for cache operations.

methods.name: getCacheManager
methods.description: Returns the current cache manager instance.

methods.name: setRootName
methods.description: Sets the root node name for cache hierarchy.

methods.name: getRootName
methods.description: Gets the current root node name for cache hierarchy.
